rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees renewing for the first time are exempt from CE.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours do not carry over to a later registration period.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, workshops and conferences offered or approved by ASWB, NASW or a CSWE-accredited school or department of social work; DPH does not pre-approve courses
rules.audit_note: Certificates must be submitted to the Department on request.

topics.who: First renewal period in which CE is required, then at least once every six years (veterans' mental health incl. suicide prevention)

rules.notes: At least 5 hours in-person or live synchronous online; no more than 10 hours asynchronous online, distance learning or home study. Renewal fee $200 (LCSW) / $125 (LMSW). Keep certificates 3 years.
